description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Sokka and Suki to trigger.
Resolve Sokka and Suki's second ability, creating a 1/1 white Ally creature token that triggers its first ability.
Resolve Sokka and Suki's first ability, attaching up to one Equipment to the Ally that triggered it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature, creating a Blood token which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl, and causing Sokka and Suki to trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
